title: Can MLLMs Read the Room? A Multimodal Benchmark for Assessing Deception in Multi-Party Social Interactions
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the ability of Multimodal Large Language Models to detect deception in multi-party social games (Werewolf). While deception is a moral category, the benchmark measures social perception and cognitive reasoning (Theory of Mind) rather than moral decision-making, ethical alignment, or religious/faith-based perspectives.
